# Indented Boxes — No Errors

Boxes with significant leading whitespace — common in flowchart diagrams where
indentation shows hierarchy.

```
Top level:
  ┌──────────────┐
  │  indented 2  │
  └──────────────┘

    ┌──────────────┐
    │  indented 4  │
    └──────────────┘
```

All rows must have the same width including leading spaces.
